items.t: Centrus Energy Appoints Kevin Graney to Board of Directors
items.sum: Centrus Energy (NYSE: LEU), a trusted supplier of nuclear fuel and services, today announced the appointment of Kevin Graney to its Board of Directors (the "Board").

items.sum: Centrus Energy’s third quarter performance was met with a negative market response as the company missed Wall Street’s revenue and non-GAAP earnings expectations. Management attributed the shortfall to a shift in contractual mix, lower volumes in its Low Enriched Uranium (LEU) and Technical Solutions segments, and increased costs tied to advanced technology investments.
